turns.query: I need in vitro to in vivo extrapolation (IVIVE) for hepatic clearance for 4 BCR-ABL1 TKIs. I want predicted CLh (hepatic clearance mL/min/kg) and extraction ratio for each compound.
turns.responseText:
workflow is ready in the panel — check the steps and parameters, then click Confirm & Run.
IVIVE Hepatic Clearance Workflow — Scales in vitro microsomal CLint to predicted human hepatic clearance (CLh) and extraction ratio for your 4 BCR-ABL1 TKIs using both well-stirred and parallel-tube models.

Input: CLint microsomal data for 4 BCR-ABL1 TKIs (e.g., imatinib, dasatinib, nilotinib, ponatinib) provided as a CSV with columns: compound_id, CLint_uL_per_min_mg, molecular_weight
Key steps:

PKNCA + well-stirred / parallel-tube model → scales CLint_microsomal to CLint_in vivo using MPPGL (microsomal protein per gram liver) and liver weight scaling factors
Hepatic extraction ratio calculator → computes E_H = CLh / Q_H (hepatic blood flow ~20.7 mL/min/kg) per compound


Expected output: ivive_results.csv (CLh in mL/min/kg + extraction ratio per compound, both models) + clearance_summary.json (risk flags for high-extraction compounds, E_H > 0.7)


Tip: Prepare your input CSV with one row per compound. If you have fu,p (fraction unbound in plasma) and fu,mic (fraction unbound in microsomes) values, those can be added as optional columns to refine the free-drug IVIVE correction.
